stages.name: 崩れた屋根
stages.description: 光が鉄骨の間に落ちる
stages.prompt: anime cinematic interior, abandoned factory hall with a broken roof, dramatic sunbeams through dust, rusted girders, green plants pushing up through concrete

stages.name: 蔦の機械
stages.prompt: beautiful anime illustration, giant rusted machinery wrapped in vines and moss, drips of water, soft green-gold light, intricate worn texture

stages.name: 水たまりの空
stages.prompt: atmospheric anime scene, flooded factory floor reflecting steel beams and sky, ripples from dripping water, calm teal and orange contrast

stages.name: 錆の通路
stages.prompt: dynamic anime perspective, long rusted catwalk between tangled pipes and tanks, shafts of light, steam hissing, deep industrial depth

stages.name: 煙突の木々
stages.description: 自然が煙突を取り戻す
stages.prompt: poetic anime scene, old brick chimney surrounded by trees at sunset, wild flowers in the yard, warm orange sky, hopeful finale

character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every shot: dark green-black hair tied in a practical knot, hazel eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a restoration engineer reclaiming an abandoned factory for nature. Fixed costume: a weathered work jacket with moss-green patches, protective trousers, gloves, and heavy boots. Signature tool or keepsake: a hand-built seed launcher made from reclaimed metal. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in collapsed hall with sunbeams, vine-covered machinery, flooded floor with reflections; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with rust orange, moss green, steel grey, sun gold; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow tracking along rusted pipes, wide shot of a collapsed roof with sunbeams, close-up of vines on machinery; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

available_styles: wide shot of a collapsed roof with sunbeams
low shot across a flooded floor
camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
